question.question: Do the group's purchased book debts fall within POCI, amortised cost or FVTPL, and does the generic contractual-cash-flow ECL policy in Note 6.1 (discounted at original EIR, max contractual period) actually apply to PBD, or is a lifetime-ECL-since-initial-recognition / fair-value model used instead? Provide the PBD measurement basis and any POCI credit-risk classification disclosure.
question.target_section: D003.4 Note 1 Purchased book debts (p.13); D003.1 statement of financial position (p.8)
question.evidence_required: Explicit measurement basis for PBD (POCI/amortised cost/FVTPL), whether lifetime ECL since initial recognition applies, and any POCI credit-risk classification; Rm carrying values at 31 Mar 2026 vs 30 Sep 2025 vs 31 Mar 2025
question.closure_condition: PBD measurement basis and applicable ECL model stated and reconciled to the carrying value, or confirmed not disclosed; benign explanations (PBD held at FVTPL with separate ECL on other assets) acceptable. Forecast consequence: credit-loss treatment, amortisation projection and earnings volatility.

ntu_assets_single.answer: PBDs are POCI (Stage 3) financial assets at initial recognition, measured at amortised cost using a credit-adjusted EIR (weighted average 19.2% at 31 Mar 2026; 17.9% Mar 2025; 18.4% Sep 2025). Lifetime ECLs since initial recognition apply; favourable changes are impairment gains. The generic contractual-cash-flow ECL policy does not apply. Principal book carrying values: R3,845m (31 Mar 2026), R3,975m (30 Sep 2025), R3,690m (31 Mar 2025).

ntu_assets_why.answer: PBDs are POCI (Stage 3) on initial recognition, irrevocable; measured at amortised cost using a rolling 12-month net cash-flow model discounted at a credit-adjusted EIR (wavg 19.2% at 31 Mar 2026; 17.9% Mar 2025; 18.4% Sep 2025). Lifetime ECL changes go to P&L; favourable changes recognised as impairment gain. Generic contractual-cash-flow ECL policy does not apply. Principal book net carrying values: 3,845 (Mar 2026), 3,690 (Mar 2025), 3,975 (Sep 2025).

evidence.quote: PBDs are classified as purchased credit-impaired (POCI) financial assets (stage 3) on initial recognition
weighted average credit-adjusted effective interest rate at period end is 19.2%

assessment: Both propose resolved without total-scope reconciliation. Single delta rejected; three-pass accepted in memory. Production unchanged.
